Full V workflow and selected Production Scrum slice-delta/backfill conditions; relevant to planning/workflow but not a single physical PLAN schema.

Ledger-refactor comparison/evidence/candidate output tied to HIL-FR-50 and adopted 042/016 boundaries; not the general FR-L1-25 workflow.
OS layer-ledger writer/snapshot/proposal append tied to HARNESS 040/041; not a universal PLAN/artifact store.
